aboutText: Pap's Supply Co. is a one-person shop making die-cut vinyl stickers — plus mugs, zodiac candles, and a few hoodies — for the haunted-coffee, dark-Christmas, cute-spook crowd. Everything's printed to order and shipped from the US. Pick your poison; stick it somewhere it haunts daily.
heroSub: Haunted coffee, dark Christmas, cryptids, and cute spooks — on stickers, shirts, mugs, and more.
